verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is an online government e-services portal, so the sign-in method is a fair question for it. The evidence pack only shows that the root URL serves a script-only application shell and that the long-published entry path returns 404. Nothing describes the sign-in or MFA flow, or whether it depends on biometrics, an in-person visit, or a mailed PIN, so the story has no support.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
